title: Apple plans to open an Apple Developer Center in Berlin in 2026, its first center in Europe and fifth globally, offering in-person developer access and sessions (David Phelan/Forbes)
summary: David Phelan / Forbes: Apple plans to open an Apple Developer Center in Berlin in 2026, its first center in Europe and fifth globally, offering in-person developer access and sessions — In an announcement that is characteristically well-timed before the upcoming Worldwide Developers Conference which kicks off on Monday …
